Froster.ext_description: Grandma never had it this easy! Automatic frosters do the tedious icing for you in 6 seconds, leaving you free for more important things - like taking new orders!

Froster.ext_description: Faster frosting means speedier service. With the Fast-Frost 2000 on the job, your only worry will be finding the time to take your lunch break!

Froster.ext_description: To manage complex cakes that demand post-frosting decoration, accelerating the icing process is a must. Essential for bakers in a rush, this machine does the trick in two seconds flat!

Decoration.name: Deco-Lite 1000
Decoration.description: Customers will pay premium prices for decorations! This candle design adds $10 to the cake price.
Decoration.ext_description: Offering special cake-toppers is a great way to bump up your prices. For special occasions, businessmen particularly like this tasteful candle decoration. Remember to frost the cake first!

Decoration.name: Rose Topper
Decoration.description: A rose by any other name would taste as sweet! This delicate decoration adds a $15 value to a cake.
Decoration.ext_description: Food critics will test your artistic skill by ordering these fancy flowers. Good thing you took Advanced Icing Techniques at culinary college!

Decoration.name: Wedding Topper
Decoration.description: This engaging topper nets you an extra $25 from the customer's wedding-cake budget.
Decoration.ext_description: No wedding is complete without the classic newlywed figurines in attendance. Expect brides to crown their orders for the big day with this romantic touch!

Decoration.name: Strawberry Topper
Decoration.description: A 'berry' sweet design that plants an extra $20 in your pocket.
Decoration.ext_description: Not just for shortcakes anymore! This topper adds a fun, fruity flair. It brings to mind pleasant thoughts of summer strawberry season, particularly for women.

Decoration.name: Deco-Deluxe 2000
Decoration.description: This nifty machine streamlines the decorating process so you can finish orders more quickly.
Decoration.ext_description: Things get hairy when everyone wants the same decorations! You can only do one of the four designs at a time, so fast topper turnover is critical to success with fancy cakes.

Decoration.name: Deco-Demon 5000
Decoration.description: This delightful device is an absolute speed demon. No more slowdowns on the finishing touches!
Decoration.ext_description: If there's one thing that hampers a skilled baker, it's a slow cake-topper. The Deco-Demon whips them up in an astonishing 2 seconds, eliminating that end-of-the-line bottleneck.

Decoration.name: Tradewinds Topper
Decoration.description: Decorated cakes sell for a tidy profit! A Tradewinds Ship adds character to a cake, and $10 to its value.
Decoration.ext_description: Spice up your cakes with the tang of high seas adventure! Delivery men are fascinated by these model sailing ships. Perhaps they're all pirates at heart?

Decoration.name: Super Granny Topper
Decoration.description: Respect your elders! Stand Super Granny atop an order and she'll dig you up an extra $15.
Decoration.ext_description: This super senior is the hands-down hero of Grannies around the world. You'll appreciate her too, for the extra profits she brings in on retirement party cakes!

Decoration.name: Slyder Topper
Decoration.description: Slyder keeps the profits rolling in, rounding prices up by $20.
Decoration.ext_description: All the cool kids are down with this spherical hero. If there are boys in the queue, expect to be seeing a lot of Slyder!

Decoration.name: Snail Mail Topper
Decoration.description: The fastest snail in the galaxy will speed you towards financial success, $25 at a time!
Decoration.ext_description: Turbo the Snail is legendary for his quick deliveries. Maybe that's why overworked holiday characters such as Cupid and the Easter Bunny like him so much!

Decoration.name: Deco-Deluxe 2000

CakeOven.name: BakePro 1000
CakeOven.description: The standard professional baker's oven. This trustworthy appliance turns out cakes in 6 seconds.
CakeOven.ext_description: Multitasking is the key to increasing profits. With an extra oven, you can fill more orders at once!

CakeOven.name: BakePro 1000
CakeOven.description: The standard professional baker's oven. This trustworthy appliance turns out cakes in 6 seconds.
CakeOven.ext_description: Multitasking is the key to increasing profits. With an extra oven, you can fill more orders at once!

CakeOven.name: BakeMaster 2000
CakeOven.description: Invest in this industrial convection oven to cut your baking time down to 4 seconds.
CakeOven.ext_description: Quicker cake turnover keeps the queue moving faster. The BakeMaster makes baking a breeze (but, sadly, leaves you less time to flirt with those delivery men)!

CakeOven.name: Lightning-Bake 5000
CakeOven.description: This state-of-the-art oven turns out delicious desserts in an amazing 2 seconds!
CakeOven.ext_description: Lightning strikes your kitchen! Stand back and watch in awe as this baker's best friend pops out perfect pastries in the blink of an eye.

CookieOven.name: Cupcake Microwave
CookieOven.description: To handle long lineups, free samples are a must! No one can stay cranky with a hot cupcake in hand.
CookieOven.ext_description: When things get hectic, a little treat will restore the temper of an impatient customer. This little microwave automatically whips up a new batch of 4 cupcakes once the last has been given away.

CookieOven.name: QuickCake Deluxe
CookieOven.description: More demanding customers need faster emergency cupcake intervention!
CookieOven.ext_description: The mighty cupcake remains your best weapon in the war against impatience. When cupids, critics, and corporate clients all turn up at once, the extra 10 seconds this oven shaves off each batch will be a lifesaver.

CookieOven.name: SpaceCake 2000
CookieOven.description: The official microwave used on the space shuttle! Guaranteed to send your cupcake production sky-high.
CookieOven.ext_description: Astronauts orbiting the Earth can't wait around all day for their cupcakes to bake, and neither can you! This powerhouse oven plows through the job in half the time.

DisplayCase.name: Display Case
DisplayCase.description: This fancy stand offers an extra place to set down a work in progress - or display a finished cake to tempt buyers!
DisplayCase.ext_description: Wound up with more cakes than hands, or made a mistake on an order? Don't dump it, display it! A frosted cake stands a 20% chance of being bought outright by an admiring customer.

TVSet.name: TV Set
TVSet.description: A television keeps customers happily distracted, buying you more time until their patience runs out.
TVSet.ext_description: Choice of TV program can be catered to your expected clientele. Kids prefer cartoons, males the news, and females the food network. Click the yellow button below the screen to cycle through the channels.

Avatar.name: Cloud Crosstrainers
Avatar.description: If you wish you could be quicker on your feet, these special sneakers leave your old shoes in the dust!
Avatar.ext_description: You'll be on Cloud Nine in these crosstrainers. They're so comfortable, it's like walking on air - you won't even realize you're running 50% faster!

Avatar.name: Wingtips
Avatar.description: Don a pair of speedy Wingtips, and you'll dodge around so quickly the customers will think you've taken flight!
Avatar.ext_description: Slip on these winged wonders and sprint twice as swiftly as usual! Hermes himself would envy this fast, feathered footwear.

Avatar.name: Smokin' Sneakers
Avatar.description: Light a fire under your heels! The hottest shoes around will have you blazing through the bakery at top speed.
Avatar.ext_description: Cake isn't the only thing that's cooking when you wear these ultra-quick sneakers. Dash through your duties three times faster than normal, and hope your sizzling soles don't set off the fire alarm!
